input: Set up a standing desk in the home office

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Standing Desk in the Home Office
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to set up a standing desk in their home office, and needs a clear plan to get it done.

questions.title: Do you already own the desk or need to buy one?
questions.description: Determines whether the plan starts with research and purchasing or jumps straight to setup.

questions.title: Is the desk manually adjustable or electric?
questions.description: The type of desk affects assembly complexity, cable management needs, and setup time.

questions.title: Does the desk require assembly from flat-pack?
questions.description: Flat-pack assembly is a major step that needs its own time and tools allocation.

questions.title: What is currently occupying that space in your office?
questions.description: Existing furniture or equipment may need to be moved, sold, or stored before setup begins.

questions.title: Do you have the tools needed for assembly?
questions.description: Identifies whether tools like an Allen key, screwdriver, or drill need to be sourced beforehand.

questions.title: What equipment will sit on top of the desk?
questions.description: Monitors, laptops, and peripherals affect cable management planning and desk load requirements.

questions.title: Do you have a target date to have it completed?
questions.description: A deadline helps prioritise steps and determine how urgently purchases or prep work must happen.
